name: Downloads
description: List or grid of downloadable files with colour-coded format badges, file-type icons, sizes, and descriptions. Layouts: rows list, icon card grid, one featured download + secondary list, grouped by category, or a two-column compact mini-list.
when_to_use: Document sections — brochures, data sheets, price lists, press kits. Use one Downloads block per page region; the grouped variant replaces multiple blocks when files span categories; compact suits dense footers/sidebars.
capabilities: colour-coded format badge (Badge atom) + file-type icon derived from the extension (override via ext field)
featured layout: one highlighted download plus a secondary list
category grouping via a free-text group label per file

variants.description: Rows: file icon + title + format badge + size, round download action. Default.
Card grid (3 col) with large file icons and descriptions.
First file highlighted as a bordered hero card, the rest as a secondary list.
Rows clustered under their items[].group headings with a per-group file count.
Two-column mini rows: format badge + title + size, no icon or card.

breakpoints.mobile: Single column rows / cards; compact collapses to one column.
breakpoints.desktop: Icon grid in 3 columns; featured splits hero + list; compact in 2 columns.

ai.prompt_summary: Downloads: file list/grid aligned to Figma 773:40748. Settings: variant (list|icons|featured|grouped|compact), eyebrow, headline, intro. Files in items[] (min 1): { title, desc (icons/featured only), file (pdf/doc/xls/ppt/zip/img/mp4/dwg/txt), ext (format override, inferred from file URL when empty), file_size (human readable, e.g. '4.2 MB'), group (grouped variant only) }. Format badge colour + file icon come from ext.
ai.content_guidelines: Titles are document names, not sentences. 3-8 files; descriptions one line. Group labels short nouns (e.g. Broschüren, Technik).

field_hints.items.ext: Only set when the format cannot be inferred from the file URL.
field_hints.items.group: Only rendered by the grouped variant.
